summary: Validated MahaFlow integration configuration, Turnstile rejection behavior, frontend production build, and responsive auth UI. Backend regression passed 4/4 and browser checks passed 5/5; real Supabase credential auth was not attempted because the credentials file is empty and Turnstile cannot complete on this preview host.

integration_issues.issue: Widget mounts with visible layout but Cloudflare reports error 110200 / no available adapters on the preview hostname, so a valid token cannot be obtained here.

action_items: Allowlist the deployed preview/production hostname in the Cloudflare Turnstile widget, then retest signup/signin and Google OAuth.
Configure and verify Supabase Auth email/password and Google provider settings before production use.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview Mongo access-code, camera, and crowd endpoints remain MOCKED/unauthenticated and must not be treated as production authorization.
Supabase Auth and Google OAuth integration is configured in code but provider behavior was not verified with a real account in this run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 UI checks); auth provider completion unverified

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST-prefixed access-code and camera records through the existing regression tests; camera records are deleted, access-code records remain because no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup status reports all three integrations configured; build passes; auth controls, Turnstile mounting, forgot-password empty validation, signup toggle, and mobile overflow pass. Continue with real Supabase email/password and Google OAuth after Turnstile hostname allowlisting.
test_credentials: None available; /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no credentials. No real auth submission was attempted.
rca of the issue: Cloudflare Turnstile loads its widget but the preview hostname/challenge environment returns error 110200 and 'No available adapters', matching the known allowlist/preview limitation. Backend correctly rejects missing or invalid tokens with 422/400 without exposing the secret.
